title: Korea's AI windfall comes with risks: Rogoff
caption:
South Korea has been a massive winner in the global hardware boom, but former IMF chief economist Kenneth Rogoff warns of a painful landing. Skyrocketing resource costs and generational wealth gaps leave public budgets exposed if tech spending slows down.

Source: Koreaherald - Korea's AI windfall comes with risks: Rogoff
